name: @inventario/desktop
description: App de escritorio — B&D Consultores · Inventario de campo

scripts.dev:compile-electron: pnpm --filter @inventario/types build && pnpm --filter @inventario/auth-invite build && node scripts/write-main-env.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.node.json && node scripts/write-main-env.mjs
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @inventario/types build && pnpm --filter @inventario/auth-invite build && node scripts/write-main-env.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.node.json && node scripts/write-main-env.mjs && vite build && cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --dir
scripts.build:installer: pnpm --filter @inventario/types build && pnpm --filter @inventario/auth-invite build && node scripts/write-main-env.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.node.json && node scripts/write-main-env.mjs && vite build && cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder
